notes.author: David Revoy <https://framagit.org/Deevad>
text: Here is finally episode 27, the first episode of a trilogy of episodes about the coronation of Coriander. This first part happens before the ceremony. It shows us a bit more about Coriander. We already saw her on previous episodes, but never really understood she was a princess (except in the last panel of “The Pyjama Party”.) I never introduced her passion for robots either. This episode tries to (finally) solve that. We also see Qualicity for the first time.

This episode was done during the month of October as a challenge with a deadline. I'm happy to be able to post it today on the 31st after days (and a few nights) of hard work. I hope you'll like it and thanks you for your patience (moving to a new house and the DIY took me time).
Thanks again to the contributors, translators, the supporters and all the readers!
